description: Source code for the BinaryTargetGenerator class, which is responsible for generating build targets in a build system, including handling source files, dependencies, and target properties.

classes.name: BinaryTargetGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating build target configurations, including source files, dependencies, and properties, for a specific build target.

methods.name: BinaryTargetGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the generator with target, scope, function call, output type, and error object.

methods.name: DoRun
methods.description: Main method executing the target generation process, setting properties, validating sources, and generating language-specific values.

methods.description: Populates the target's source files and validates their types.

methods.name: FillCompleteStaticLib
methods.description: Sets the 'complete static lib' property if applicable.

methods.name: FillFriends
methods.description: Populates the list of friend targets.

methods.name: FillOutputName
methods.description: Sets the output name of the target.

methods.name: FillOutputPrefixOverride
methods.description: Sets whether to override the output prefix.

methods.name: FillOutputDir
methods.description: Sets the output directory for the target.

methods.name: FillAllowCircularIncludesFrom
methods.description: Configures circular include dependencies, validating that labels are in dependencies.

methods.name: FillPool
methods.description: Assigns a pool to the target if specified.

methods.name: ValidateSources
methods.description: Validates source files for language compatibility and optional Rust crate root.

methods.name: FillModuleName
